_comment: Enemy kinds: rules layered on top of an ordinary part-built enemy. Generated fights roll tracker/bomber/warden/hive by column (see data/run/run.json). `builds`: sets down a pad beside itself that builds a drone every `every` rounds (the hive's drone). sorter: the gate's boss (013). reclaimer: the drones that arrive in fights near the Reclaimer's line (013).

tracker.name: Tracker
tracker.text: Its attack locks onto a machine, not a hex. The shot follows that machine: break its line of sight, get out of range, kill it or shove it.

bomber.name: Bomber
bomber.text: Explodes when destroyed: 4 damage to every neighbour, its own side included.

warden.name: Warden
warden.text: Its neighbours take 2 less from every hit.

hive.name: Hive
hive.text: Sets down a fabricator pad beside itself. Every 2 rounds the pad builds a drone, and warns the turn before. Stand on the pad to block it; destroy the hive to shut it down.

sorter.name: The Sorter
sorter.text: The Sorting Gate's keeper. While any gate pylon stands it takes 3 less from every hit: break the pylons first. Every 3 rounds it calls a drone from a pad beside it, warning a turn ahead.

reclaimer.name: Reclaimer drone
reclaimer.text: The Reclaimer's own. Fight near its line and they come in behind you: red hexes on your back row mark where, a round ahead. Stand on one to block it.

sentinel.name: Sentinel
sentinel.text: Old yard guard, plated and bolted down: takes 1 less from every hit and cannot be shoved.

pour.name: The Pour
pour.text: The Slag Flats' keeper. Every other round it marks the hexes your machines stand on; a round later they flood with slag for the rest of the fight (2 damage a round to anything on them). Keep moving, and break it before the floor runs out. At half HP it BOILS OVER: it marks every round, four hexes, the slag bites for 3, and three drones come to guard it.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.text: The Foundry Mind's relay (the Crucible). Every machine of its side standing next to it hits 1 harder -- the red links show which. Kill it, shove it off, or split them up.

heart.name: The Core
heart.text: The Crucible's heart, bolted to the floor: it never moves and cannot be shoved. Every third round it marks every hex within 2 of it, and a round later it pulses: 4 damage to each of your machines still in the ring. Its pad builds a drone every 4 rounds. Break it and the Reclaimer stops. At half HP it ERUPTS: it pulses every other round, 3 hexes out, for 5, and calls three drones.
